_note: Owner 2026-10-19: 'make sure that deepseek cannot run during peak hours ... build something that allows for scheduling'. Read live by opencode_free.py (off_schedule): a model inside one of its blocked windows - or within lead_minutes before one - counts as resting, so no new session starts on it; a session already running is not stopped. Times are in the window's tz; days are Mon..Sun names or ranges (Mon-Fri). Add a model by copying an entry. DeepSeek peak (OpenCode Go docs, https://opencode.ai/v2/docs/console/go/ and DeepSeek's pricing page): 01:00-04:00 and 06:00-10:00 UTC, Monday to Friday; weekends are off-peak (Chinese public holidays are also off-peak but are not modelled - those days simply stay blocked).
